_comment: Extra namespace mappings for the Majorsilence.Forms migrator (Track D), passed via --map reporting.map.json. D1 (WinformUtils) needed none of this. D4 (RdlDesign) needs ScintillaNET redirected to a compat shim -- see RdlDesign.Forms/Syntax/ScintillaCompat.cs, which defines a `Scintilla` class (matching the original type name post-prefix-rewrite) plus stub versions of every ScintillaNET.* enum/const-holder/event-args type RdlDesign actually uses (Lexer, WrapMode, IndentView, AutomaticFold, MarginType, MarkerSymbol, IndicatorStyle, SearchFlags, UpdateChange, UpdateUIEventArgs, StyleNeededEventArgs, Style, Marker), all in the same Majorsilence.Reporting.RdlDesign.Syntax namespace so this single prefix mapping covers everything.
